name: Krasnaya ognennaya loshad
source:
The last days before the New Year are the exact time when you most acutely feel that something in life has gone wrong, as you replay the events of the passing year in your head.

A routine trip, an accidental breakdown, and a concert in a dirty basement club unexpectedly bring together people who had long since gone their separate ways.
One is stuck in the past, clinging to established things and habits.
Another has lost himself in the future, where success no longer brings joy, but only anger and misunderstanding.

This story, as strange as it may sound, is not about miracles and not about a fairy tale.
This story focuses on music, honest conversations, and those rare moments when the people who truly matter end up right by your side.

And sometimes, for things to start making sense again, it is enough to simply be in the wrong place at the wrong time, but with the right people.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3626310342]Steam[/url]]
